_comment: The canonical cases for to_identifier(), read by BOTH suites.
The ontology editor previews what a typed name will become before it is
submitted, which means the rule is implemented twice — once in Python at
app/services/ontology_generator.py and once in JavaScript at
frontend/src/api/ontology.js. Two implementations of one rule drift.
This file is the contract: backend/tests/test_ontology_generator.py and
frontend/tests/unit/ontology.spec.js both assert against it, so a change
to either side that is not a change to the other fails immediately.
